info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Billing Reviews API
info.description: The Corporate Billing Reviews API facilitates the submission and management of feedback related to corporate billing services. This API allows users to create reviews that enhance service transparency and aid organizations in optimizing their billing processes. The typical consumers include finance teams and corporate clients who wish to provide insights on their billing experiences. By leveraging this API, businesses can ensure improved billing practices and foster better client relationships.

post.summary: Create a review for a corporate billing transaction.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for a specific corporate billing transaction identified by PAY-300045. The review content should adhere to the established guidelines to ensure proper processing and feedback collection.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a review for the corporate billing service associated with Pay ID PAY-300045. It takes a JSON object formatted according to the specified schema, which includes necessary fields for providing feedback and ratings regarding the service.
